from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A provided paper and its citation relationships with other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's full title as named")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper, if mentioned in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
